clock_repair: Brainsets blockwise repair verified against raw NWB trial time fields

channel_exclusion: Processed source excludes raw channel 1 for malformed spike timestamp blocks; no model-dependent selection

unit_audit.status: Physical position scale unresolved: NWB declares meters with NaN conversion; retain native numeric scale, do not label m/s
unit_audit.velocity_computation: Trial-local numerical position derivative in seconds; mean instantaneous speed within bin
unit_audit.behavior_smoothing: None added; positions are supplied by original source
unit_audit.conversion_evidence: Converter copies native HAND X/Y positions and explicitly passes conversion=np.nan; no physical calibration is supplied
unit_audit.missing_behavior: Hand-position samples end before nominal trial stop; insufficiently covered bins remain NaN while neural counts and target labels are retained

label_split.procedure: sklearn train_test_split 10% test, then 1/9 remaining validation; ceil rounding

data_use: All retained neural rows for unsupervised representation learning; split applies only to labels (transductive/offline)
